red_file_search.pro


Routines

top source red_file_search

SST pipeline

result = red_file_search(searchstring [, dir], count=count [, remote_dir=string] [, remote_login=boolean or string] [, /verbose])

Search for files using the shell "find" command, optionally on a remote node.

Can be used instead of file_search() for simple searches. Should be faster for directories with many files.

Return value

Returns all matched filenames in a string array, one file name per array element. If no files exist with names matching the input arguments, a null scalar string is returned instead of a string array.

Parameters

searchstring
dir in optional type=string

The (local) directory in which to do the search.

Keywords

count
remote_dir in optional type=string default=dir

Set this to the remote node's equivalent of the dir parameter.

remote_login in optional type=boolean or string

If true, then use ssh to do the find operation on a remote node. If a string, use it as the node name (or as user@nodename).

verbose in optional type=boolean

Be verbose!
